note: 'Of' spans many relations (possession, part-whole, role) while 'About' specifically marks topic/aboutness, so they are not general synonyms (e.g. 'Prime Minister of Canada' cannot become 'Prime Minister About Canada').
'Train station' and 'railway station' denote the identical class of facility, differing only by US/UK dialect preference.
'Divide' and 'separate' overlap only in the 'split into parts' sense but diverge elsewhere (e.g. couples 'separate' but don't 'divide'; arithmetic division isn't separation), so not general synonyms.
Patient (undergoer of a change of state, e.g. cancellation) and Theme (entity located/described without necessarily changing state) are distinct thematic roles, not freely interchangeable.
